questions: Is a progression defined as an arithmetic progression, a geometric progression, or any sequence that follows a simple pattern?
If arithmetic progression, is the common difference required to be an integer, or can it be any real number (though inputs are integers)?
If geometric progression, is the common ratio required to be an integer, or can it be rational/real?
Does a progression require at least three terms, or is any two-element sequence considered a progression?
If arithmetic, is a constant sequence (all elements equal) considered an arithmetic progression?
If geometric, is a sequence with zero elements allowed? Constraints say A_i >= 1, but if ratio zero, later terms would be zero.
Should the output be case-sensitive? 'Yes'/'No' vs 'YES'/'NO' or other variants?
Is a progression defined strictly as following the pattern exactly for all given terms, or approximately within some tolerance?
